text:
samir: incident-bot alerted about spike in 5xxs and tool-call failures for several customer routes in eu-west-1 around 2062500000
incident-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: smart-routing-policy: high-fallback-rate (eu-west-1 -> us-east-1), error-type: TOOL_CALL_UNSUPPORTED, rate: 18% over 1m :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Pager sent to oncall@eng-runtime (samir) :pager:
mira: I'm pulling logs now, can someone drop the affected routes/customer ids?
samir: affected routes: /chat, /tooling/chat; customers: acme-inc, stratus-ai, petgram (enterprise tenants).
alex: i'm seeing a lot of responses with: `{"error":"tool_call not supported by model_variant: redwood-m-13b-quant-v2"}` in the eu-west-1 proxies
carmen: that variant is the quantized fallback we rolled out in the region earlier today during the autoscale test.
ryan: omg so smart-routing is falling back across region to a variant that doesn't support function-calls. that's why tool calls blow up.
mira: logs show policy decision: `fallback_to_variant: redwood-m-13b-quant-v2` for requests when local capacity < threshold. the compat matrix entry for that variant lists tool_call=false.
samir: timeline: 2052508000 config pushed to smart-routing (allowed cross-region fallback to any compatible size). then 2062500000 error spike.
ops-sre: can we force-routing to stay in-region and pin to fp16 variants until we patch policy?
alex: i'll push temporary override to route matching `/tooling/*` to `redwood-m-13b-fp16` in eu-west-1 and disable cross-region for that route. command:
```
rbctl routing set --route "/tooling/*" --region eu-west-1 --model redwood-m-13b-fp16 --override-temporary 30m
```
mira: applying now. watch logs.
incident-bot: ACTION: routing override accepted by control-plane, change-id: ch_9073
ryan: after override traffic for tooling routes -> fp16, error rate dropped from 18% -> 0.4% in 2m :thumbsup:
ops-sre: can we also blacklist the quantized variant for cross-region fallback? I don't want it to be considered until we fix compat flags.
samir: adding policy change: set `fallback.allow_variants` to explicit list (exclude quant variants) and push.
```
PATCH /smart-routing/policies/uuid
{
  "fallback": { "allow_variants": ["redwood-m-13b-fp16","redwood-m-7b-qloader"] }
}
```
alex: pushed patch, control-plane returning 200.
incident-bot: Control-plane policy update applied (policy_uuid: uuid)
carmen: quick customer impact note: acme-inc reported degraded tool-based workflows for ~18m, two support tickets opened. we've posted status update to status.redwood.ai and customer Slack channels.
mira: root cause: compat matrix had wrong flag for redwood-m-13b-quant-v2 (tool_call: true) in the policy decision service; during fallback policy evaluation, variant was considered compatible and picked. quantized build actually compiled without tool-call support.
ryan: filed bug: INFR-6321 compat-matrix sync bug. need two actions: 1) reconcile build metadata -> compat matrix, 2) add unit test to policy engine to verify tool_call capability before selecting fallback.
ops-sre: will also add an e2e test that simulates tool_call traffic and verifies fallback behavior in staging.
samir: customer impact summary for pager: 3 customers affected, degraded function for 18m, mitigated by routing override + policy patch. no data loss. engineering response time: 6m to first mitigation.
carmen: handoff to next oncall in 30m. i'll prepare notes.
mira: Handoff summary:
- what happened: smart-routing picked a quantized variant across region that lacks tool_call support -> tool_call errors.
- mitigation applied: temporary route pin to fp16 variants, blacklisted quant variant in fallback policy.
- next steps: reconcile compat matrix, add tests, coordinate with build team to mark quant builds correctly, plan a rollback window for the quant variant release.
- customers notified: acme-inc, stratus-ai, petgram. support tickets: #4532, #4533, #4534.
- followup doc: ENG-INCIDENTS/INFR-6321 (will create)
ops-sre: taking handoff at 2062501800. i'll keep monitoring for 2hrs.
samir: thanks all. please add any postmortem notes to the incident doc and link to the control-plane diff (ch_9073).
alex: note for followup: add a blocking check in the smart-routing policy evaluator to consult the compat-matrix flag `supports_tool_call` before returning a fallback variant.
ryan: i'll own the compat-matrix fix. estimated ETA for patch and tests: 1 day for hotfix + 3 days for integration tests.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — monitoring mode. metrics: error-rate back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
